justification: Caleb doesn't sit, doesn't blink, full stop — 18.4 on paper and he's playing a Thursday night game against a Patriots D that can't cover anybody, that's not a decision, that's Tuesday. Kincaid's got nobody to line up against this week — Buffalo's got the week off — so he comes out clean and Goedert, the guy I bought off the wire for exactly this, steps in at full strength. Brown fumbled it away in a 110-48 humiliation last week, and talent doesn't get a pass on the ball in this building — ball security in a loss is a character issue, so he sits on principle, no eulogy, and Burden gets the rep in the same Thursday window instead, a kid with something to prove who's outscoring him on the sheet anyway. Judkins is Questionable and Pollard's standing on the bench fully healthy within a point of him on paper — after getting hung for 48 points last week I'm not walking back into Sunday on a maybe when a sure thing with comparable juice is sitting right there. Jeanty, Skattebo, Downs, Reichard and the Lions D stay put because they're not broken and I don't redecorate a house that isn't on fire. Rinna wants a Reunion Special, she can have one — we don't stream quarterbacks, we don't bench ours, and we still cobble together the best eleven standing and go win it.
